description: This file contains a utility class 'SqlBuilderUtil' with static methods for transforming string arguments into corresponding Java objects, such as null, empty string, integers, or doubles. It also includes helper methods to validate if a string represents an integer or a double.

classes.name: SqlBuilderUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for transforming string arguments and type checks related to SQL building.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Converts a string argument into an appropriate Java object: null, empty string, integer, or double, depending on the input.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the given string represents an integer number.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Checks if the given string represents a double (floating point) number.
